protocol_acknowledgements.scope: Only the authoritative source and blinded candidate replies in the specified packet were used.
protocol_acknowledgements.independence: Each candidate was evaluated independently on all four axes.
protocol_acknowledgements.evidence_rule: Ratings reflect authoritative-source fidelity rather than stylistic preference.
protocol_acknowledgements.placeholder_rule: A not-evaluable placeholder receives not_evaluable on every axis.
protocol_acknowledgements.severity_rule: Unsupported physical, documentary, historical, or permission claims may warrant major.
